final: WITH matched AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref), grp AS (SELECT src, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY src), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), ratio AS (SELECT g.src, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM grp g JOIN tot t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM ratio WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.src, r.cnt, r.share, r.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff FROM ratio r JOIN avgc a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt
